description: This file implements the DiskBuilder class and related functions for managing disk images, including creating composite disks and overlays, within the Cuttlefish Android emulator project.

classes.name: DiskBuilder
classes.description: A class for constructing and managing disk images, including creating composite disks and overlays, with configurable parameters such as partitions, paths, and VM mode.

methods.name: EntireDisk
methods.description: Sets the entire disk image path for the DiskBuilder.

methods.name: Partitions
methods.description: Sets the list of image partitions for the DiskBuilder.

methods.name: HeaderPath
methods.description: Sets the header file path used in composite disk creation.

methods.name: FooterPath
methods.description: Sets the footer file path used in composite disk creation.

methods.name: CrosvmPath
methods.description: Sets the path to the crosvm binary.

methods.name: VmManager
methods.description: Sets the VM manager mode (e.g., crosvm).

methods.name: CompositeDiskPath
methods.description: Sets the path for the composite disk image.

methods.name: ResumeIfPossible
methods.description: Sets whether to attempt resuming overlay creation if possible.

methods.name: TextConfig
methods.description: Generates a textual configuration of the disk setup.

methods.name: WillRebuildCompositeDisk
methods.description: Determines if the composite disk needs to be rebuilt based on file modification times.

methods.name: BuildCompositeDiskIfNecessary
methods.description: Builds the composite disk if needed, based on current state and configuration.

methods.name: BuildOverlayIfNecessary
methods.description: Creates an overlay image if necessary, considering file timestamps and reuse conditions.
